verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph API documentation confirms an official, scoped-token-based API path for posting channel messages (channel-post-messages) and bots can read/post in conversations via the Bot Framework, supporting agent-driven channel interaction. However, evidence doesn't show a unified 'read' API alongside post (reading channel messages via Graph requires additional permissions/APIs not detailed here), nor any hands-on confirmation of an agent using scoped tokens end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit documentation of reading channel messages via Graph API with scoped tokens, and independent/hands-on validation of an agent performing both read and post operations through official APIs.
